tagline: 理光便携相机，1985 年发布
description: 理光于1985年推出的便携相机。配备Ricoh Lens 35mm f/3.9, 3 elements in 3 groups。快门速度Programmed, 1/30 ~ 1/500 sec.。感光度ISO 100 / 200 / 400 / 1000 (by DX-code system)。Single-point active autofocusing system。

specs.镜头: Ricoh Lens 35mm f/3.9, 3 elements in 3 groups
specs.取景器: Albada type, bright-frame, 0.48X, field of view 84%
specs.英文简介: The AF-45 is an autofocus point-and-shoot camera for 35mm film, introduced by Japanese manufacturer Ricoh in 1985.
